metadata.title: Dow falls 175 points on losses for NVIDIA Corp., Honeywell stocks - MarketWatch

content.text:
Dow Update
Dow falls 175 points on losses for NVIDIA Corp., Honeywell stocks
The Dow Jones Industrial Average is falling Thursday morning with shares of NVIDIA Corp. and Honeywell delivering the stiffest headwinds for the index.
The Dow Dow Jones Industrial Average was most recently trading 176 points lower (-0.3%), as shares of NVIDIA Corp. NVIDIA Corp. and Honeywell Honeywell International Inc. have contributed to the blue-chip gauge's intraday decline.
